Aspen Acres, Custer County. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 3) back to the local unit will occur 
tomorrow. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and 
smoldering. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area and road closures in 
effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT is also 
managing the Elk incident. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
uphill runs, creeping and torching. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and 
trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, 
brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with uphill runs, creeping and torching. Area, road and trail closures in 
effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active 
fire behavior with group torching, short-range spotting and backing. Numerous structures threatened. 
Evacuations, area and road closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Moderate fire behavior with single tree torching, creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. Area, road 
and trail closures in effect. 
 
Lumin, Sheridan County. Twenty-two miles east of Sheridan, WY. Grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior. 
Residences threatened. Last report unless significant activity occurs.
